events.title: Dozens more illegal crossings prevented on Latvia-Belarus border

articles.text: Dozens more illegal crossings prevented on Latvia-Belarus border Share Follow: Follow LSM on Google Photo: LETA, Ivars Soikāns Latvijas-Baltkrievijas robeža pie Silenes Augšdaugavas novada Skrudalienas pagastā. November 5, 10:20 Defence On Wednesday, November 4th, State Border Guard officers prevented 22 people from illegally crossing the Latvian-Belarusian state border, according to the border guard's own figures. In total, 38 violators were detected at the external borders and within the country, including a Latvian citizen who is wanted by the police and was caught while traveling from the United Kingdom to Riga Airport. He was detained and handed over to State Police officials. Meanwhile one Russian and one Belarusian citizen were denied entry to Latvia at the Terehova border checkpoint due to security reasons. The individuals were returned to their countries of origin. Four citizens of Uzbekistan, one of Belarus, one of Moldova and one of Ukraine were detected at the border control point in Pāternieki and at Riga Airport, who had violated the conditions of stay (exceeded the period of stay specified in the visa, did not have a valid visa or residence permit, exceeded the period of stay specified in the visa-free regime) in the Schengen area countries. During immigration control measures within the country, violations of entry or residence regulations were detected for four individuals – one citizen of Armenia, one citizen of India, one citizen of Sudan, and one citizen of Tajikistan. Additionally, State Border Guard officials held 16 individuals administratively liable or prevented them from crossing the border for violations in the field of vehicle and vessel operation – four citizens of Belarus, three of Russia, two of Latvia, two of Romania, one of Lithuania, one of Armenia, one of Moldova, one of Ukraine and one of Uzbekistan. It is proving to be another busy week for Latvia's State Border Guard. On Tuesday, November 3, State Border Guard officers prevented 38 people from illegally crossing the Latvian-Belarusian state border and on Monday, November 2, State Border Guard officers prevented 20 people from attempting to illegally cross the Latvian-Belarusian state border. In total, 12,718 people have been prevented from illegally crossing the state border this year. Seen a mistake?
